data.headline: BRI Life captured 11.4% of new APE in Q4 2024, driven by bancassurance acceleration through BRI's 33,000 outlet network
data.situation: Indonesian life insurance industry premiums grew 9.3% YoY to Rp238.71T in FY 2024, with bancassurance now accounting for 42% of new business APE — the highest share since OJK began tracking.
data.complication: Health claim ratio reached 139.5% in 1H 2024 (AAJI), squeezing underwriting margins across all 15 major players. BRI Life's ratio held at 121% but is rising.
resolution: Bancassurance APE grew 41% YoY for BRI Life, outpacing the industry's 18% average
BRI Life ranks #5 in market share but #2 in growth velocity among top-10 players
RBC 434.6% provides 3.6x regulatory headroom for product expansion in 2025
data.source: OJK Statistik Perasuransian FY 2024; AAJI Q4 Bulletin; BRI Life Annual Report

data.headline: Appendix — Methodology, data sources, and definitions

sections.title: Data sources
items: OJK Statistik Perasuransian: monthly aggregate, quarterly company-level data
AAJI Quarterly Bulletins: industry-wide health and life claim data
Company audited financial statements: APE, premium, RBC, claim breakdowns
Internal MIS: BRI Life channel-level cross-sell and conversion data

sections.title: Definitions
items: APE (Annualized Premium Equivalent): regular premium + 10% of single premium
RBC (Risk Based Capital): solvency ratio; OJK minimum 120%
Claim Ratio: incurred claims / earned premium; less than 100% is profitable
Bancassurance Mix: APE through bank distribution / total APE

sections.title: Caveats
items: FY 2024 figures are audited; Q1 2025 figures are preliminary
PSAK 117 restatement of FY 2024 not yet published by all companies
Market share calculations exclude sharia subsidiaries unless noted
Industry growth rates use AAJI weighted aggregates
